description: While supportive of the enforcement blitz, Reilly remains concerned over the lack of a field test to aid law enforcement in the detection of marijuana-impaired driving. No such test exists at this time and though there are several being developed by the private sector, none are near ready for wider field implementation. Even then, state law prohibits the odor of marijuana alone from being used as a way to identify drug-impaired driving.
